title: Godzilla Stars Get Big Cheers in Tokyo
summary:
The stars of the new film Godzilla Minus Zero came to the 39th Tokyo International Film Festival on Sunday. Just two days earlier, they were at the film's first showing in Los Angeles. The new movie opens in Japan in two days.

Kamiki Ryunosuke plays Shikishima Koichi, and Hamabe Minami plays his wife, Noriko. Kamiki said the fans' energy was amazing. In the 900-seat theater, people clapped and clapped. Some fans wore Godzilla outfits, held big posters, and asked for autographs. When director Yamazaki Takashi came to sign, fans shouted 'TAKASHI!' again and again.

Child actor Nagatani Sae plays Akiko. In the last film, Godzilla Minus One, she was very young. This time, she learned all her lines by heart.

Kamiki said the new story begins about two years after Minus One. Hamabe put the gap at two to three years. Minus One earned more than 7.65 billion yen, or $50 million, in Japan and won a prize at the Oscars.
